column1: # drift-patterns.tsv — fluency-trap regex catalog for Mentl
# Format: mode_num<TAB>mode_name<TAB>regex<TAB>scope<TAB>notes
# scope: ka | all | <comma-separated exts, e.g., ka,lux>
# mode_num 1-9 = CLAUDE.md drift modes; 10+ = bug-classes and keyword drift
# Suppress a single line with a trailing `# drift-audit: ignore` comment.
# Append patterns; do not edit the script.
# ROOT: every pattern here is a syntactic tell of ONE violation — THE
# CARRIED-TRUTH LAW (protocol_carried_truth_law.md): the graph proved X; a
# consumer re-derived / discarded / fabricated / cached X instead of reading
# it live. vtable(1), string-keyed(3), parallel-arrays(7), flag-as-int(8) are
# re-derivation tells; the `_ => <fabricated>` row is the fabrication tell.
# This file is the proto-`mentl audit` — the medium's drift detector, inside
# the medium. Post-L1 the patterns become predicates over graph shapes.

column5: A record of functions named like a vtable is Mentl drawn as Rust. Use graph + handler.
Env lookup is an effect op — the bare call `env_lookup(name)` — no parent-pointer frame walk.
Effect names are EffName ADTs. Raw strings flatten parameterization.
Flat effect names. Post-H3.1, EffName is parameterized ADT. These strings signal the old shape.
Compose with ~> chains, not stacked handle(handle(handle(...))).
Unified __state per H1 substrate. Separate __closure and __ev is the pre-H1 shape.
Nullary ADTs share compilation discipline. Bool special-casing is drift.
Frame consolidation (Ω.5): one record + sorted-set, not parallel arrays.
Paired _h arrays surface a record-shape begging to exist.
Flag-as-int is an ADT begging to exist. H6 will catch it anyway.
Tokens are ADTs post-Ω.4.
SchemeKind is ADT post-H3.
Land whole or surface as named peer handle. No deferred-in-committed-code.
Same as above — surface as peer handle in ROADMAP.md.

column1: # --- Bug classes from CLAUDE.md that have cost hours ---

column5: Wildcard fabricates a Scheme. Enumerate variants explicitly.
Fabricated TVar silently absorbs a new variant.
String-Pure default. Use EffRow algebra.
A bug is zero or blocking. No `|| true` to hide a gate.
Delete, don't decorate. No removal comments.
Unused variables are deleted, not renamed with underscore.
println inside report(...) handler arms corrupts WAT stdout.

column1: # --- Foreign-language keyword drift (the fluency trap surface) ---

column5: `impl` is Rust. Mentl has handlers on the graph.
Rust keywords. ADTs are declared with Mentl's own grammar.
`def`/`class` are Python. Functions in Mentl are `fn`, structure is ADT.
Lambda is a Python keyword. Canonical Mentl closure: (params) => body (the `|x|` fence is itself drift — mode 36).
Do-notation is monad-transformer drift (mode 4). Use ~> chains.
C primitives. Mentl has ADTs + refinement types.
Async is an effect in Mentl, handled — not a keyword.
Mentl has no classes. `new`/`self`/`this` are OOP drift. Anchored to `\w` after the dot to avoid false positives on prose "this."/"self." with sentence breaks.

column1: # --- Mentl-native shape violations (residue discipline) ---

column5: Loops are rarely the Mentl shape. Use |> transforms or <~ feedback. If truly needed, justify in a comment and suppress.
Anchor 6 + H1.3: if components carry _h suffix, reach for a record.
Env is effect-mediated — the bare op call `env_lookup(name)` — not a function parameter.

column5: Amendment A. Canonical: (params) => body. `|x|` pipe-fence is not Mentl syntax.
Amendment A. `|a, b|` form is drift. Use (a, b) => body.
Amendment J. Iteration: |> / <~ / Iterate. Early-exit: Abort effect. (Fires on code lines; comment-only lines excluded by ^[^/]* prefix.)
Amendment R. `fn (x) =>` drift. Canonical: (x) => — `fn` keyword reserved for named declarations only.
Amendment I. Canonical: resume() — Parameters-ARE-Tuples + No-Redundant-Form.
Amendment Q. Visibility via capability effects, not modifier keywords.

column1: # --- Σ-/// drift (doc-comment doctrine; SYNTAX.md §Comments §Doc comments) ---

column5: Σ-///. JSDoc/JavaDoc tags forbidden inside ///. Effect row + refinement substrate already carries that information.
Σ-///. Sphinx directives forbidden inside ///. Mentl has no Sphinx; substrate carries the structure.
Σ-///. No internal headers inside ///. Declaration name IS the heading.
Σ-///. Positive-form discipline (CLAUDE.md global). Doc shows what IS, not what was.
Σ-///. Subjective-gating language shouldn't appear in substrate-derived voice. Either the tentacle's silence_predicate fires or it doesn't.
Σ-///. // ═══ decorations are flat-file scaffolding. Pattern A: delete. Pattern B: consolidate to /// lede. Pattern C: strip ═══, keep plain // text.

column1: # --- Disintermediation drift (mascot-as-command-prefix; F.1) ---

column5: Per CLAUDE.md sharpened drift 38 + CLI-canonical-vocabulary.md §3.3 (2026-05-07). Project-action verbs (mentl edit/doc/run/test/audit/serve/teach/query/repl/new/compile/check) are CANONICAL — the binary IS named Mentl; subcommand prefix is structural like `git commit` / `cargo build`. Drift fires only on tentacle-named verbs that shadow at-cursor projections (Trace/Why/Propose/Unlock/Verify/Topology). Note: `mentl teach` and `mentl query` are project-action peer transports for terminal users (per EH alias table), NOT drift.

column1: # --- Mode 40: SYNTAX-surface dissolutions (SYNTAX.md is the authority) ---
# At-zero ratchets over the wheel read-path: each names a form SYNTAX.md
# dissolved. Out-of-band archaeology (crucibles/, tools/editor samples,
# bootstrap/test repros) may still carry these — the ratchet flags them on
# touch; the wheel (src/ lib/ tests/) is clean.

column2: SYNTAX-surface drift (/// dissolved — one comment form)
column5: SYNTAX.md §Comments: the //-vs-/// split is dissolved. One comment form: //. Every comment is graph content attached to the next decl.
SYNTAX.md §Imports: no `import X as Y`. An alias is a redundant second name for an edge the import already drew; narrow the selective set.

column2: SYNTAX-surface drift (:: is not a token)
column5: SYNTAX.md §Imports one-separator law: `.` is the one access operator; `/` only at import position. `::` is not a Mentl token.
SYNTAX.md §Generic type parameters: no turbofish, no angle brackets anywhere. The case rule IS the declaration (lowercase in type position = type param).

column2: SYNTAX-surface drift (perform dissolved — bare op call)
column5: SYNTAX.md §Invoking effect operations: an effect op is a BARE CALL. `perform` is format-lifted (E_RedundantPerform); the env binding proves op-ness.

SYNTAX.md §tee: `~>` is the one install verb. The `handle { body } with h` block spelling and the `handle expr with h` inline spelling both format-lift to `(body) ~> h`; state and arms live at the handler DECLARATION.

column1: # --- Mode 10 (cont.): empty/zero surrender-fallbacks (fabrication tells) ---
# Comment-guarded (^[^/]*) so a doc example does not false-positive. A GENUINE
# null sentinel is either enumerated per-variant (ty_handle_of) or documented +
# suppressed inline (`// drift-audit: ignore — <why>`); an undocumented one is a
# surrender-fallback to delete/restructure, never wrap.

column5: Empty-string surrender-fallback. Document + suppress a genuine String-null sentinel inline; otherwise delete/restructure — never wrap.
Zero-handle surrender-fallback. Enumerate the ADT (ty_handle_of reads the handle live per-variant, 0 only for ground types) — a wildcard 0 masks a missing case.
